introduction: Healthy Connections is South Carolina Medicaid. Apply online, request a paper form or contact a county eligibility office.
description: Healthy Connections is South Carolina Medicaid. Apply online, request a paper form or contact a county eligibility office.

sections.who: The state reviews financial circumstances and coverage categories including children, pregnancy, caregivers, disability and older adults. Low income alone does not establish every adult’s eligibility.
sections.get: Approved coverage helps pay eligible medical bills. Read your category and plan information for covered services.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Start with Healthy Connections

    Use the state intake page or call 888-549-0820.

  2. Supply requested information

    Use the state document-upload route when additional records are requested.

  3. Read the decision

    Check each applicant’s result and any managed-care instructions.
sections.after: Keep contact details current and respond to annual review notices.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Coverage and intake, Program-specific eligibility, Document upload. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can SC Thrive help me apply?
The Medicaid agency lists SC Thrive as an application-help provider.
Can I request a paper application?
Call 888-549-0820 or use the downloadable form.
The state Forms page links its document-upload tool for matching records to your case.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
